changelog:
RedReplier Mean Marketer 1.0.0

- Adds an automated background loop to surface high-scoring RedReplier lead opportunities and roast users who ignore them, using server-generated, mean but humorous messages.
- Relies entirely on server-side logic for lead selection, roasting, and criteria; this skill just relays the messages and links without modification.
- User can configure lead threshold, loop enablement, profanity, and target website via simple commands.
- Requires manual setup of a scheduled polling job (every 5 minutes recommended) to run, as there is no automatic polling or webhook.
- Designed for users seeking automated, "mean accountability" nudges for marketing on platforms like Reddit, Hacker News, X, and Bluesky.
